kicker: Dukaan pe busy the, call miss ho gaya
title: Missed call = *customer jo kisi aur ko call karega*.
message:
Namaste 🙏 [Business] mein call karne ke liye shukriya.
Abhi customer ke saath hain, *[15 min]* mein call karte hain.
Jaldi hai? Yahin likh dijiye: kya chahiye?
why: customer ko *turant jawab* mil gaya, wo agla number dial nahi karta. Aur jo likhta hai, use pehle call karo.
caption:
Har business mein din ke kuch calls miss hote hain. Customer wait nahi karta, agla number milata hai. 📞

Fix:
1️⃣ Missed call pe 1 min mein WhatsApp (auto bhi ho sakta hai)
2️⃣ "15 min mein call karte hain"
3️⃣ "Yahin likh dijiye": aadhe log likh dete hain
4️⃣ Shaam ko list: kaun reh gaya

Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
